title: Differential rank preservation manifold learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Manifold learning methods like t-SNE and UMAP preserve local neighborhoods, but they do not preserve the ranking of the neighbors inside them. Two embeddings can return the same neighbor set while disagreeing on which point is closest. This loss of order degrades downstream applications that value the order in the embedding. We propose Smooth Rank t-SNE (SR-tSNE), which adds a differentiable rank term to the standard t-SNE loss. To enable efficient training, this term uses a sigmoid rank approximation to explicitly force a point's true high-dimensional neighbors to outrank unrelated intruders and retain their original order. We also introduce Ordinal DLP (O-DLP), an extension of the Degree of Locality Preservation (DLP) metric that credits a neighbor only when it returns at its original rank. Across eight benchmarks spanning image, text, speech, remote-sensing and single-cell data, SR-tSNE outperforms 12 baselines in rank preservation

translated_abstract: 像t-SNE和UMAP这样的流形学习方法能够保持局部邻域，但它们并不能保持邻域内邻居的排序。两个嵌入可以返回相同的邻居集合，却在哪个点最近的问题上不一致。这种顺序信息的丢失会损害重视嵌入中顺序的下游应用。我们提出了Smooth Rank t-SNE（SR-tSNE），它在标准t-SNE损失中添加了一个可微分的秩项。为了实现高效训练，该项使用sigmoid秩近似来显式地强制一个点在高维空间中的真实邻居超越无关的“入侵者”并保持其原始顺序。我们还引入了序数DLP（O-DLP），这是局部保持度（DLP）指标的扩展，只有当邻居以其原始排名返回时才给予认可。在涵盖图像、文本、语音、遥感和单细胞数据的八个基准测试中，SR-tSNE在秩保持方面超越了12个基线方法。
tldr: 提出SR-tSNE方法，通过在t-SNE损失中加入基于sigmoid的可微分秩项来保持高维邻居的排序，并引入O-DLP评估指标，在八个跨领域基准上超越12个基线方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes SR-tSNE, which preserves neighbor rankings by adding a differentiable sigmoid-based rank term to the standard t-SNE loss, and introduces the O-DLP metric, outperforming 12 baselines across eight benchmarks spanning diverse data domains.
